name: Purphoros — devotion counts only its controller's permanents
notes: Memory: project_devotion_per_controller_fix_2026-04-21. Devotion was summed over all players. The opponent controls two Goblin Chainwhirlers (6 red symbols), so global red devotion is 7 or more. Purphoros (p1) has devotion 1 and must not be a creature.
